title: First China stop: Shanghai or Guangzhou? | China Travel Expert
description:
First stop in China: Shanghai or Guangzhou? Two very different front doors.

That red building gliding past in Shanghai is the old China Pavilion from Expo 2010 — it reopened on 1 October 2012 as the China Art Museum, one of Asia's largest art museums and free to enter. Head south instead and Guangzhou meets you with early-summer lychee season and 'Lychee King' (荔枝王) stalls on the street. One city is skyline and art; the other is food and heat. Pick your first stop.

🧭 Expert Tip: Land in Shanghai first for an easy start (big airport, Metro, English signage), then take the ~8-hour high-speed train — or a ~2.5-hour flight — south to Guangzhou when you want the food side of China.

第一站去上海还是广州？一个看天际线逛艺术馆，一个吃荔枝叹早茶。
